description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' gains [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage.
description.text: Passive: Dr. Mundo gains  bonus attack damage.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range, and deal '''bonus''' physical damage, increased by 0% – 40% (based on '''Dr. Mundo's missing''' health)[[Category:Debug]]. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take 100% AD physical damage plus ''Blunt Force Trauma's'' minimum '''bonus''' damage.
description2.text: Active: Dr. Mundo empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage, increased by 0% – 40% (based on Dr. Mundo's missing health)Category:Debug. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take 100% AD physical damage plus Blunt Force Trauma's minimum bonus damage.

description3.raw: ''Blunt Force Trauma'' as well as the triggering attack's damage is increased to 140% against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and 140% against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description3.text: Blunt Force Trauma as well as the triggering attack's damage is increased to 140% against minions and 140% against monsters.

description4.raw: ''Blunt Force Trauma [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Dr. Mundo's''' basic attack timer.''
description4.text: Blunt Force Trauma resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.

notes.text:
Blunt Force Trauma's damage is treated as basic damage but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage, while the target's body being shoved deals area damage to enemies it passes through.
* The basic attack is also considered a part of Blunt Force Trauma and treated as both basic damage and spell damage.
Blunt Force Trauma's attack works against structures, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.
Blunt Force Trauma cannot knock back wards, structures or epic monsters it kills, nor champions that enter a zombie state upon dying.
Targets flung away are rendered untargetable in the process.
The damage of the enemy's corpse colliding with enemies does not benefit from Blunt Force Trauma's attack critically striking.
